summary: Quiet residential kerb near the corner; cars park here, but homes are close.

best_section.where: South kerb just east of the Oxford Terrace corner, beside the tree cover

drivers.seclusion: Apartments 12 m away at 31 m and houses 6-10 m further along; Oxford Place 27 m away. Corner end is treed.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with parked cars on both sides; room to park at the kerb.
drivers.convention: Cars park along the kerb, so a van blends in.

flags: Steep: about 7% grade at the best section, 15% max
No Stopping signs near the corner end
Homes close on the south side
sun_shade: Trees at the corner shade the west end; open to morning and afternoon sun otherwise.
